description: This file defines the interface for a PolicyBuilder in the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides a fluent API to construct and manipulate Policy objects, including managing labels, subjects, resources, permissions, lifecycle, revision, creation/modification timestamps, and policy entries. The interface supports scoped building with labels, including setting, removing, and configuring subject identities, resources, and permissions, both granted and revoked.

classes.name: PolicyBuilder
classes.description: An interface for building and modifying Policy objects with various methods to set properties, manage entries, and scope configurations by labels. Supports the creation of immutable Policy instances.

classes.name: PolicyBuilder.LabelScoped
classes.description: A sub-interface extending PolicyBuilder that allows scope-specific configuration based on a particular label. Provides methods to set subjects, resources, permissions, and to exit label scope.

methods.name: forLabel
methods.description: Creates a label-scoped PolicyBuilder for a specific label.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the policy ID, either by string or PolicyId object.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Sets the policy's revision, either by number or revision object.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Replaces existing policy entry with the provided entry.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Replaces all policy entries with the provided iterable.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a policy entry by label.
